name: agent-desktop-mcp
description: Use Vercel agent-desktop for scoped local desktop inspection and accessibility-based actions.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and operate desktop apps through accessibility
interface.longDescription: Use Vercel agent-desktop to inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, operate controls and pointer gestures, manage windows and notifications, use the clipboard, and inspect agent-desktop sessions and traces. Operations stay within a fixed command set.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the open app and summarize its visible controls.
Use the accessibility snapshot to click the named control in this window.
